families.topic: all-hazards response phases, escalation, roles and recovery
evidence_points: The plan provides an overarching framework for significant public-health threats and business-continuity incidents.
It uses an all-hazards approach and covers situational awareness, alerting, assessment, response and recovery.
It describes incident-response levels and escalation and de-escalation parameters.
It sets out command, control, coordination, people-management and recovery principles.
